verdict.rationale: LiveKit is a cloud platform that processes user voice, video and data and runs AI inference, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, a data-use policy, or a no-training commitment. The ability to self-host or move off LiveKit Cloud is an adjacent deployment option, not a control over AI training use, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
